title: hermie-chart block
description: The body of a fenced code block whose language is `hermie-chart`, as docs/charts.md describes it. A JSON null for `title` or `unit` is the same as an absent key; a null `type`, `x` or `series` is refused. Rules that JSON Schema cannot say are in docs/charts.md and are enforced by the validators: every `values` list is exactly as long as `x`, categories (numbers written out as text) and series names are unique after trimming, every string is trimmed (an empty `title` or `unit` is absent, an empty category or series name is refused), a pie's values are not negative with at least one above zero, lengths are counted in characters as a reader sees them, and the text of the block is at most 16384 bytes of UTF-8, checked before it is parsed.
